name: civil-litigation-eu-civil-procedure
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU civil procedure and cross-border litigation. Covers Brussels I Recast (Regulation 1215/2012) on jurisdiction and enforcement, Rome I (Regulation 593/2008) on applicable law for contracts, Rome II (Regulation 864/2007) on applicable law for torts, European Enforcement Order, European Small Claims Procedure, European Account Preservation Order, European Order for Payment, Hague Choice of Court Convention, service of documents, evidence taking, mediation, collective redress, and key concepts including lis pendens, forum non conveniens, exequatur abolition, anti-suit injunctions, interim measures, and limitation periods.
author: ANTON Legal Team
regulation_ids: Hague Convention on Choice of Court Agreements (2005)
